y-m-56-08.title: Kirasi ipi inoshandisa kirasi library zvakanyanya?
y-m-56-08.topic: Kuenzanisa data: huwandu nema ratios, neruzivo runodiwa kuenzanisa
y-m-56-08.goal: Ziva kuti huwandu hwevadzidzi vakashandisa hahukwani kuenzanisa kuti kirasi imwe neimwe yakashandisa zvakadii, taura ruzivo runodiwa pakuenzanisa (huwandu hwevadzidzi vose), uye ugadzire nyaya dzinokodzera mamiriro kana ruzivo rutsva rwapiwa.
y-m-56-08.material: Mwedzi wapfuura, vadzidzi 12 muKirasi A nevadzidzi 9 muKirasi B vakashandisa kirasi library yechikoro. Hatisati taziva huwandu hwevadzidzi vose mukirasi imwe neimwe. Pano, 'kirasi yakashandisa zvakanyanya' zvinoreva 'kirasi apo ratio yevadzidzi vakashandisa library kuvadzidzi vose mukirasi iri yakakwirira'. Rangarira kuti kirasi imwe neimwe inogona kuva nehuwandu hwevadzidzi hwakasiyana.
y-m-56-08.prereq.0: Ratio (saizi yechikamu zvichienzaniswa nechose) nekuenzanisa saizi ye fractions
y-m-56-08.prereq.1: Pfungwa pfupi ye relative frequency (frequency ÷ total frequency) (middle-school level)
y-m-56-08.s.s1.prompt: Neruzivo rwatinarwo zvino chete, kirasi ipi yatinogona kutaura kuti ine ratio yekushandisa yakakwirira?
y-m-56-08.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza huwandu hwevadzidzi vose hunogoneka hwekirasi mbiri idzi uye uverenge ratio imwe neimwe.
y-m-56-08.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana kuti kirasi ipi iri yakakwirira inochinja zvichienderana nehuwandu hwawakasarudza.
y-m-56-08.s.s1.o.a: Kirasi A (nekuti vadzidzi 12 vakashandisa, iri hombe)
y-m-56-08.s.s1.r.a: Kutonga uku kunotora huwandu hwevashandisi sekukura kweratio. Tarisa kana kuchiri kushanda kana huwandu hwose hwakasiyana.
y-m-56-08.s.s1.o.b: Kirasi B (nekuti kirasi ine vadzidzi vashoma vakashandisa pamwe ine vadzidzi vashoma vose)
y-m-56-08.s.s1.r.b: Yakaverenga huwandu hudiki hwevadzidzi vakashandisa sekuti huwandu hwose hwevadzidzi hwuri hudikiwo. Verenga zvakare kana huwandu hwevadzidzi hwose hwakapiwa.
y-m-56-08.s.s1.o.c: Kirasi mbiri dzinosiyana nevadzidzi 3 vakashandisa chete, saka ma ratios anenge akafanana
y-m-56-08.s.s1.r.c: Kutonga uku kunoverenga musiyano wehuwandu hwevadzidzi semusiyano weratio. Tarisa kuti chii chinoitika kana kirasi dzine huwandu hwevadzidzi hwakasiyana.
y-m-56-08.s.s1.o.d: Kana tisingazivi huwandu hwose, hatigoni kuziva kuti kirasi ipi iri yakakwirira
y-m-56-08.s.s1.r.d: Kutonga uku kunoti ratio ichikamu chakaenzaniswa nechose, saka haugoni kuenzanisa usingazivi chose.
y-m-56-08.s.s1.explain: Ratio ihuwandu hwevadzidzi vakashandisa hwakaparadzaniswa nehuwandu hwose hwevadzidzi mukirasi. Kana usingazivi huwandu hwose, haugoni kuziva kana vadzidzi 12 iratio yakakwirira. Semuenzaniso, kana Kirasi A ine vadzidzi 60, 12/60 = 0.2, uye kana Kirasi B ine vadzidzi 20, 9/20 = 0.45, saka Kirasi B yakakwirira, uye kana Kirasi A ine vadzidzi 15 uye Kirasi B ine vadzidzi 30, Kirasi A yakakwirira.
y-m-56-08.s.s2.prompt: Unoda kusarudza kuti kirasi ipi ine rate yekushandisa yakakwirira. Sarudza zvimedu zvose zveruzivo zvaizokubvumira kuenzanisa nekungoziva chimedu chimwe chete, pasina rumwe ruzivo. (Pangava nezvakawanda.)
y-m-56-08.s.s2.hint.0: Kune ruzivo rwesarudzo imwe neimwe, tarisa imwe neimwe kana ichikuita kuziva 'huwandu hwose hwevadzidzi mukirasi'.
y-m-56-08.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kana pane isingashandiswi kuwana ratio kunyange ukawana ruzivo.
y-m-56-08.s.s2.r.a: Kutonga uku kunoti iyi ndiyo ruzivo runopa denominator yeratio zvakananga.
y-m-56-08.s.s2.o.b: Huwandu hwose hwemabhuku ari pamashelufu e kirasi library
y-m-56-08.s.s2.r.b: Tarisa kuti saizi ye library haishandiswi kusarudza ratio yevadzidzi vakashandisa.
y-m-56-08.s.s2.o.c: Avhareji yenguva dzakatora mabhuku nevadzidzi vakashandisa
y-m-56-08.s.s2.r.c: Kuti vakatora kangani ndiwo mwero wakasiyana ne 'ratio yevadzidzi vakashandisa'.
y-m-56-08.s.s2.o.d: Huwandu hwevadzidzi mukirasi imwe neimwe vasina kushandisa
y-m-56-08.s.s2.r.d: Kutonga uku kunoti kuvawedzera kuhuwandu hwevadzidzi vakashandisa kunopa huwandu hwese, saka unogona kuziva denominator zvisina kunanga.
y-m-56-08.s.s2.explain: Kuti uwane ratio, unoda huwandu hwevadzidzi vese mukirasi. Kana uchiziva huwandu hwevadzidzi vasina kushandisa, unogona kuwedzera huwandu hwevakashandisa (12 ne 9) kuwana huwandu hwese, saka i ruzivo rumwechete rwakapiwa nenzira yakasiyana. Huwandu hwese hwemabhuku kana avhareji yekukwereta hazvishandiswi mukuenzanisa nechiyero ichi.
y-m-56-08.s.s2.acc.0: Kusarudza huwandu hwevadzidzi vese mukirasi imwe neimwe chete kwakakwanawo. Tarisawo kuti huwandu hwevadzidzi vasina kushandisa, hwakawedzerwa ku 12 ne 9, hunopa huwandu hwese, saka i ruzivo rumwechete.
y-m-56-08.s.s2.acc.1: Huwandu hwevadzidzi vasina kushandisa oga hwakakwana, nekuti hunokuita kuti uzive huwandu hwese. Zvakafanana nekuziva huwandu hwevadzidzi vese zvakananga.
y-m-56-08.s.s3.prompt: Wakawana kuti Kirasi B ine vadzidzi 25 vese (vadzidzi 9 vakashandisa, saka ratio yekushandisa i 9/25 = 0.36). Pa huwandu hwevadzidzi vese n muKirasi A upi apo ratio yekushandisa yeKirasi A (12/n) i yakakwira kupfuura yeKirasi B? Wana mitengo 3 yakasiyana ye n inogutsa mamiriro. (Vadzidzi 12 muKirasi A vakashandisa, saka n i integer ye 12 kana kupfuura.)
y-m-56-08.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wawana, se decimal, n apo ratio yeKirasi B 0.36 neratio yeKirasi A 12/n zvakaenzana.
y-m-56-08.s.s3.hint.1: Sarudza n imwe, verenga 12/n, uye uienzanise ne 0.36.
y-m-56-08.s.s3.var.n: Huwandu hwevadzidzi vese n muKirasi A (vadzidzi)
y-m-56-08.s.s3.ok.c1: Huwandu hwese hweKirasi A i integer ye 12 kana kupfuura.
y-m-56-08.s.s3.fail.c1: Vadzidzi 12 vakashandisa, saka huwandu hwese hunofanira kuva integer ye 12 kana kupfuura.
y-m-56-08.s.s3.ok.c2: Ratio yekushandisa yeKirasi A i yakakwira kupfuura yeKirasi B (0.36).
y-m-56-08.s.s3.fail.c2: Kune n iyi, 12/n i 0.36 kana kushoma. Tarisa zvinoitika kuratio kana huwandu hwese hweKirasi A hwakadzika.

y-m-56-03.topic: Kukosha kudiki zvikuru kwebasa: mhedzisiro inochinja sei nedomain (mhando ye x)
y-m-56-03.goal: Ziva kuti kunyange nechirevo chimwe chete, kukosha kudiki zvikuru kunogona kuramba kuri kwakafanana, kuchinja, kana kusavapo zvachose zvichienderana nemhando ye x (domain), uye gadzira mhando dzinosangana namamiriro.
y-m-56-03.material: Funga basa f(x) = x² − 4x + 5. (x² inoverengwa 'x sikweya'.) Kukosha kushoma ndi f(0) = 5, f(1) = 2, f(2) = 1, f(3) = 2, f(4) = 5. Kana pasina mhando ye x yakapiwa, x inogona kuva nhamba chaiyo ipi neipi. Ngatichinjei mhando ye x uye titarise zvinoitika kukosha kudiki zvikuru (minimum) kwa f.

y-m-56-03.thinking.2: Gadzira mhando dzinosangana namamiriro nenzira dzakati wandei dzakasiyana
y-m-56-03.prereq.0: Kuisa kukosha muchirevo che quadratic x² − 4x + 5 uye kuverenga

y-m-56-03.s.s1.hint.0: Pachikamu chega chega, tanga watarisa kana x = 2 iri mukati memhando.
y-m-56-03.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora kukosha kwa f pamigumo miviri yemhando padivi pekukosha kwa f pa x = 2, uye uzvienzanise.
y-m-56-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Mhando ye x: nhamba chaiyo dzose. Pakati pe f(0) kusvika f(4) zvakanyorwa pamusoro, kukosha kudiki zvikuru ndi 1 (kana x = 2). Hausati wataridza kana kukosha kuchidzikira pa x dzimwe.
y-m-56-03.s.s1.st.0.after: f(x) inogona kunyorwa se (x − 2)² + 1, saka 1 pa x = 2 ndiko kudiki zvikuru. Pa x = 1.5 ndi 1.25 uye pa x = 2.5 ndi 1.25, uye zvose zvakakura kupfuura 1.

y-m-56-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Uku kungava kutonga kwakashaya chimiro chekukosha patafura, kunoderera wobva wakwirazve.

Tarisazve shure uye ufunge kana chikonzero chokuchinja kutonga kwako chaiva kwete chirevo asi mhando (kana x = 2 yaiva mukati, kana migumo yaisanganisirwa).
y-m-56-03.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza nhamba dzizere p, q (p < q) kugadzira mhando p ≤ x ≤ q kuti kukosha kudiki zvikuru kwa f(x) = x² − 4x + 5 mumhando iyi kuve 2 chaizvo, uye utsvage mapeya matatu akasiyana (p, q). (Ngatiti p ne q inhamba dzizere kubva pa −30 kusvika pa 30.)
y-m-56-03.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga watarisa kuti kukosha kudiki zvikuru kunova chii kana x = 2 iri mumhando.
y-m-56-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kana x = 2 iri kunze kwemhando, yedza kuti kukosha kudiki zvikuru kunoitika pamugumo upi wemhando.
y-m-56-03.s.s2.ok.c1: p ne q inhamba dzizere uye p < q.
y-m-56-03.s.s2.fail.c1: p ne q dzinofanira kuva nhamba dzizere kubva pa −30 kusvika pa 30, uye p inofanira kuva diki kupfuura q.
y-m-56-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Kukosha kudiki zvikuru mumhando iyi ndi 2.
y-m-56-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Kukosha kudiki zvikuru kwemhando iyi hakusi 2. Tarisa kana x = 2 iri mukati memhando, uye kukosha kudiki zvikuru kunoitika pamugumo upi wemhando.
y-m-56-03.s.s2.explain: Kana x = 2 iri mukati memhando, kukosha kudiki zvikuru ndi 1, saka izvozvo hazvishande. Kana x = 2 iri kunze kwemhando, kukosha kudiki zvikuru kunoitika pamugumo uri padhuze ne 2. Kana mhando yose iri kurudyi kwa 2, kudiki zvikuru ndi 2 kana p = 3 (f(3) = 2), uye kana mhando yose iri kuruboshwe kwa 2, kudiki zvikuru ndi 2 kana q = 1 (f(1) = 2). y-m-56-02.title: Equation yegirafu yakatamiswa yakaenda zvisirizvo papi?
y-m-56-02.topic: Kutamisa girafu: kuongorora equation yegirafu yakatamiswa
y-m-56-02.goal: Kana uchinyora equation mushure mekuti girafu yatamiswa, usavimbe nemutemo wakayeukwa wenzira nechiratidzo chete; ongorora equation nepoinzi yegirafu yakatamiswa inofanira kupfuura nayo, uye uone kuti kutamisa kumwe kupfuura kumwe kunogona kukodzera mamiriro.
y-m-56-02.material: Girafu yefunction y = |x| ichimiro che 'V' ine vertex pa (0, 0), umo y = 1 zvose kana x = 1 nekana x = −1. (|x| inoverengwa 'absolute value ye x'.) Minjae akanyora kugadzirisa kuwana equation yegirafu inowanikwa nekutamisa girafu iyi ne2 kurudyi (munzira yakanaka ye x-axis).
y-m-56-02.thinking.0: Ongorora mutsara wega wega wekugadzirisa kuti unoenderana nemutsara wakapfuura
y-m-56-02.thinking.2: Ona kuti kutamisa kumwe kupfuura kumwe kunogona kukodzera mamiriro
y-m-56-02.prereq.0: Chiratidzo cheabsolute value nechimiro chegirafu ye y = |x| (kuongorora kwechiyero chechikoro chepakati)
y-m-56-02.prereq.1: Kuisa kukosha kwe x muequation yefunction kuwana y
y-m-56-02.s.s1.hint.0: Isa zvakananga poinzi (2, 0) yawakawana mumutsetse 2 muchirevo chemutsetse 3.
y-m-56-02.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa mutsetse wega wega nomutsetse uri pamberi pawo, rimwe panguva imwe.
y-m-56-02.s.s1.line.0: Chirevo chegirafu yekutanga ndi y = |x|, uye vertex yayo ndi (0, 0).
y-m-56-02.s.s1.line.1: Kana yatamiswa 2 kurudyi, vertex inofamba kuenda ku (2, 0).
y-m-56-02.s.s1.line.2: Yakatamiswa +2 munzira ye x, saka tsiva x muchirevo na x + 2 uye unyore y = |x + 2|.
y-m-56-02.s.s1.line.3: Saka chirevo chegirafu yakatamiswa ndi y = |x + 2|.
y-m-56-02.s.s1.explain: Nzvimbo yekutanga apo zvinokanganisa ndimutsetse 3. Mutsetse 2 unoti vertex inova (2, 0), asi kana ukaisa x = 2 muchirevo y = |x + 2| chomutsetse 3, unowana y = 4, saka hairi kupfuura papoinzi (2, 0). Mutsetse 4 unongotakura chirevo chomutsetse 3, saka unokanganisawo.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.prompt: Nzira iri pachena zvikuru yokutarisa kuti mhedziso yaMinjae yakanganisa ndeipi?
y-m-56-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mapoinzi api ari pagirafu yakatamiswa awatoziva.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.hint.1: Isa macoordinate epoinzi iyoyo muchirevo uye utarise kana kuenzana kuchishanda.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.o.a: Isa vertex yakatamiswa (2, 0) muchirevo chitsva y = |x + 2|
y-m-56-02.s.s2.r.a: Wakaedza kana poinzi yaifanira kupfuurwa negirafu yakatamiswa ichisangana nechirevo chitsva.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.o.b: Isa x = 0 muchirevo chitsva y = |x + 2| uye utarise kana y = 2
y-m-56-02.s.s2.r.b: Wakatarisa chete kuti kuverenga kunoshanda mukati mechirevo chitsva. Hauna kuienzanisa nepoinzi yawatoziva pagirafu yakatamiswa.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.o.c: Isa x = 2 muchirevo chekutanga y = |x| uye utarise kana y = 2
y-m-56-02.s.s2.r.c: Wakaedza chirevo chepamberi pokutamisa. Kuverenga uku hakugoni kukuudza kana chirevo chishure kwokutamisa chinoenderana negirafu yakatamiswa.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.o.d: Bvuma 'yakatamiswa ne +2, saka nyora +2 muchirevowo' sechakarurama uye uenderere mberi
y-m-56-02.s.s2.r.d: Wakavimba mutemo wokuti chiratidzo chenzira nechiratidzo chiri muchirevo zvakafanana. Kuti mutemo wakarurama here kunofanira kutariswa nepoinzi.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.explain: Kana ukaisa poinzi (2, 0), iyo girafu yakatamiswa inofanira kupfuura napo, muchirevo chitsva, unowana y = 4, izvo zvinoratidza kukanganisa. Chirevo chekare (a) kana kuverenga mukati mechirevo chitsva (b) hazvigoni kukuudza kana 'chinoenderana negirafu yakatamiswa'.
y-m-56-02.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino, kubva pazvirevo zvechimiro y = |x − h| + 1, gadzira chimwe chine girafu inopfuura papoinzi (0, 4). Tsvaga kukosha kuviri kwakasiyana kwa h. (|x − h| inoverengwa 'kukosha kwakazara kwa x bvisa h'.)
y-m-56-02.s.s3.hint.0: Isa x = 0, y = 4 muchirevo uye ugadzire chirevo che h.
y-m-56-02.s.s3.hint.1: Yedza kukosha kuri pamusoro nokuri negative kwa h uye utarise kana y ichiita 4.
y-m-56-02.s.s3.ok.c1: Kana x = 0, y = 4, saka inopfuura papoinzi (0, 4).
y-m-56-02.s.s3.fail.c1: Kana ukaisa x = 0, y haiite 4. Isa x = 0 muchirevo uye utarise kuna h.
y-m-56-02.s.s3.explain: Kuisa x = 0, y = 4 kunopa |h| + 1 = 4, ndiko kuti, |h| = 3, saka h = 3 kana h = −3. Na h = 3 girafu yakatamiswa 3 kurudyi, uye na h = −3 yakatamiswa 3 kuruboshwe, uye zvose zvakakwidzwa ne 1.

y-m-56-01.title: Kuenderana uku kunogona kunzi function here?
y-m-56-01.topic: Zvinoreva function: kuenderana umo yega yega input inopa mugumisiro mumwe chete
y-m-56-01.goal: Edza kuenderana kwega kwega nemamiriro ekuti input yega yega inopa mugumisiro mumwe chete, rongedza kuti ndeapi mafunction, gadzirisa kuenderana kusiri function kuti kuve function, uye ugadzire function inoita mamiriro pachiyero chemakosha ayo.
y-m-56-01.material:
Mukirasi yevadzidzi 28, mudzidzi wega wega ane nhamba imwe yekuvapo kubva pa1 kusvika pa28, uye mudzidzi wega wega ane mubairo wekuzvarwa umwe chete (usashandisa makore e leap). Kuenderana umo input yega yega inopa mugumisiro mumwe chete kunonzi 'function'. Pano, mugumisiro unoreva nhamba imwe (kana nhamba imwe yekuvapo); migumisiro yakawanda haiverengwi sechisungo chimwe. Pane kuenderana ina pazasi.
(가) nhamba yekuvapo → mwedzi uyo mudzidzi akazvarwa (Ndira kusvika Zvita)
(나) mwedzi wekuzvarwa (Ndira kusvika Zvita) → nhamba dzekuvapo dzevadzidzi vakazvarwa mumwedzi iwoyo
(다) nhamba yechisikigo → nhamba yemadivisors enhamba iyoyo
(라) nhamba yechisikigo → nhamba dzinova madivisors enhamba iyoyo

y-m-56-04.title: Poinzi C inofanira kuenda kupi kuti igadzire katatu rine mativi maviri akaenzana?
y-m-56-04.topic: Chinhambwe pakati pemapoinzi maviri pacoordinate plane nemakatatu ane mativi maviri akaenzana
y-m-56-04.goal: Enzanisa zvinhambwe pakati pemapoinzi maviri uchishandisa macoordinate, vaka mapoinzi anogadzira katatu rine mativi maviri akaenzana nenzira dzakati wandei dzakasiyana, uye usarudze nyaya isiri katatu (zvose pamutsetse mumwe).
y-m-56-04.material: Pacoordinate plane pane A(0, 0) ne B(4, 0). Unoda kusarudza poinzi C(x, y) ine x-coordinate ne y-coordinate zvose nhamba dzizere uye ugadzire katatu ABC. Sikweya yechinhambwe pakati pemapoinzi maviri ndi (musiyano wakarara) wakaitwa sikweya + (musiyano wakamira) wakaitwa sikweya. Saka AB² = 16, AC² = x² + y², BC² = (x − 4)² + y². (Kuenzanisa masikweya ekureba kunopa mhedzisiro imwe chete sokuenzanisa kureba pasina square root.)
y-m-56-04.thinking.0: Shandura mamiriro okuva nemativi maviri akaenzana (mativi maviri akareba zvakafanana) kuva kuenzanisa zvinhambwe
y-m-56-04.thinking.1: Vaka mhinduro dzakawanda dzakasiyana mukati momuganho
y-m-56-04.prereq.0: Dzidziso yaPythagoras (nhanho yechikoro chepakati): hypotenuse yekatatu rine kona yakarurama rine mativi maviri ari musiyano wakarara nomusiyano wakamira
y-m-56-04.prereq.1: Kuverenga macoordinate emapoinzi pacoordinate plane nechirevo chekatatu rine mativi maviri akaenzana
y-m-56-04.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza nyaya dzose umo katatu ABC rine mativi maviri akaenzana.
y-m-56-04.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora nzira dzose dzokuita peya yemativi maviri pakati pemativi matatu (AB, AC, BC), ane mazita akasiyana.
y-m-56-04.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora zvinoreva 'katatu rine mativi maviri akaenzana' nemashoko, uye utarise kana mativi ose matatu anofanira kuenzana.
y-m-56-04.s.s1.r.a: Kutonga uku kunoti nyaya apo divi rimwe AB rinoenzana nedivi rimwe AC inewo mativi maviri akaenzana.
y-m-56-04.s.s1.o.b: Mativi ose matatu anofanira kuva akareba zvakafanana
y-m-56-04.s.s1.r.b: Kana wakafunga katatu rine mativi maviri akaenzana sekatatu rine mativi ose akaenzana chete, fungidzira katatu umo mativi maviri chete akaenzana.
y-m-56-04.s.s1.r.c: Kutonga uku kunoti nyaya apo mativi maviri asiri AB akaenzana inewo mativi maviri akaenzana.
y-m-56-04.s.s1.r.d: Kutonga uku kunoti divi rinonzi AB rinogona kuva rimwe remativi akaenzanawo.
y-m-56-04.s.s1.explain: Katatu rine mativi maviri akaenzana rinongoda mativi maviri pamatatu aro kuva akareba zvakafanana. Mativi matatu haafaniri kuenzana ose (iyoyo nyaya yekatatu rine mativi matatu akaenzana). Saka AB = AC, AC = BC ne AB = BC dzose nyaya dzekatatu rine mativi maviri akaenzana.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza poinzi C(x, y) umo x ne y dzose nhamba dzizere, y ≠ 0 (nokuti inofanira kuva katatu), |x| ≤ 10 ne |y| ≤ 10, kuti katatu ABC rive nemativi maviri akaenzana. Tsvaga mapoinzi C 4 akasiyana.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora AB², AC², BC² uchishandisa x ne y, wobva wafunga rimwe panguva imwe kuti mbiri dzazvo dzingaenzana dzipi.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza poinzi imwe, verenga masikweya ekureba kwemativi matatu, uye utarise kana chero ipi yazvo ichienzana.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Inhamba dzizere, y haisi 0, uye dziri mukati memhando.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.fail.c1: x ne y dzinofanira kuva nhamba dzizere kubva pa −10 kusvika pa 10, uye y haifaniri kuva 0.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Mativi maviri akareba zvakafanana, saka katatu rine mativi maviri akaenzana.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Pakati pe AB, AC ne BC hapana mativi maviri akareba zvakafanana. Verenga masikweya ekureba kwemativi matatu uye uaenzanise.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.explain: Poinzi ine x = 2 (semuenzaniso (2, 1), (2, −3)) ine AC = BC. Kuna (0, 4) ne (0, −4), AC² = 16 = AB², uye kuna (4, 4) ne (4, −4), BC² = 16 = AB². Kana y = 0, saka A, B ne C ari pamutsetse mumwe, saka haisi katatu.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Paradzanisa mapoinzi awakagadzira nemakafanana, uye kune boka rimwe nerimwe nyora mativi maviri akareba zvakafanana. Nyorawo kuti sei wakasiya mapoinzi ane y = 0.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nyora x-coordinate dzemapoinzi ako padivi pedzimwe.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Tsanangura nemashoko, pasina mufananidzo, kuti A, B ne C zvakaiswa kupi kana y = 0.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakataura here kuti mapoinzi ako anowira mumarudzi mangani?
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Kurudzi rwega rwega, wakatarisa here nezvirevo kana nhamba kuti mativi maviri api akaenzana?
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Wakatsanangura here, uchishandisa nzvimbo dzemapoinzi, kuti sei haisi katatu kana y = 0?
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.model.0: Poinzi ine x = 2 iri panhambwe imwe kubva ku A ne B, saka AC = BC. (0,4) kana (4,4) iri panhambwe 4, kureba kwakafanana ne AB, saka AB = AC kana AB = BC. Kana y = 0 mapoinzi matatu ari pamutsetse mumwe saka hapana katatu, saka ndakaasiya.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.model.1: Kana x-coordinate ye C iri 2, iri pamusoro pepakati pe A ne B, saka AC ne BC zvakafanana, uye kana iri poinzi iri panhambwe 4 kubva ku origin kana ku B, yakaenzana ne AB. Kana y iri 0, A, B ne C ari pamutsetse mumwe, saka haagadzire katatu.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Yakatsanangurwa nemashoko, asi kuparadzanisa kuva marudzi kwakajeka.

y-m-56-05.title: Kutsvaga mutsetse unosangana papoinzi (1, 3) chete
y-m-56-05.topic: Nzvimbo dzemitsetse miviri: kusangana papoinzi imwe chete
y-m-56-05.goal: Ziva kuti kana mitsetse miviri ichisangana hazvigoni kusarudzwa kubva pamhedzisiro yokuyedza kukosha kushoma chete, paradzanisa mamiriro okusangana papoinzi imwe chete (slope dzakasiyana) nenyaya apo mitsetse inopindirana, uye ugadzire mutsetse wakadaro iwe pachako.
y-m-56-05.material: Mutsetse L ndi y = 2x + 1. Poinzi (1, 3) iri pamutsetse uyu (kuisa x = 1 kunopa y = 3). Ikozvino unoda kusarudza mumwe mutsetse M wechimiro y = mx + n (m ne n inhamba dzizere). Tanga watarisa kuti nzira ipi yokutonga kana mitsetse miviri ichisangana inovimbika, wobva wavaka mutsetse M unosangana ne L papoinzi (1, 3) chete. Funga mutsetse sokuenderera pasina mugumo kumativi ose mbiri.
y-m-56-05.thinking.0: Enzanisa kuti nzira dzakasiyana dzokutonga dzakarurama zvakadini
y-m-56-05.thinking.1: Vaka mitsetse yakati wandei inosangana namamiriro (poinzi inopfuurwa, slope)
y-m-56-05.prereq.0: Chirevo che slope m mugirafu yebasa remutsetse y = mx + n (nhanho yechikoro chepakati)
y-m-56-05.prereq.1: Kuisa macoordinate epoinzi muchirevo kutarisa kana mutsetse unopfuura napo
y-m-56-05.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza nzira dzose dzinokubvumira kugumisa kuti mutsetse y = 2x + 1 nomutsetse y = 2x + 5 'havasangani'.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.hint.0: Isa x imwe chete muzvirevo zvose zviviri uye, pakukosha kushoma kwa x, nyora kuti musiyano wekukosha kwa y unoita sei.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kana mhedzisiro ingava yakasiyana pa x yausina kuyedza, pamwe chete nechokwadi chokuti mutsetse unoenderera pasina mugumo.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.o.a: Enzanisa slope dzezvirevo zviviri uye utarise kuti dzakaenzana uye ma y-intercept akasiyana
y-m-56-05.s.s1.r.a: Kutonga uku kunoshandisa slope ne y-intercept kuona kana mitsetse miviri iri kure nomumwe nomumwe.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.o.b: Isa x = 1, 2, 3, 4 uye utarise kuti kukosha kuviri kwa y hakuenzani nokuti
y-m-56-05.s.s1.r.b: Wakayedza chete kukosha kushoma kwa x. Funga kana pachine mukana wokuti vanosangana pa x yausina kuyedza (dhesimali, nhamba huru, nezvimwewo).
y-m-56-05.s.s1.o.c: Dhirowa mitsetse miviri papepa, uye kana isingaratidzike ichisangana, sarudza kuti haisangani
y-m-56-05.s.s1.r.c: Vangasangana kunze kwechikamu chawakadhirowa. Tarisa kana wakafunga kuti mutsetse unoenderera pasina mugumo.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.o.d: Tarisa kana chirevo 2x + 1 = 2x + 5, chakagadzirwa nokuenzanisa zvirevo zviviri, chingagadziriswa
y-m-56-05.s.s1.r.d: Kutonga uku kunoti kana paine poinzi yokusangana, panofanira kuva ne x apo y dzezvirevo zviviri dzakaenzana.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.explain: Kana slope dzakaenzana uye y-intercept dzakasiyana, musiyano wekukosha kuviri kwa y ndi 4 inogara iri pa x yega yega, saka mitsetse haisangani. Chirevo chakagadzirwa nokuenzanisa hachigoni kugadziriswa na x ipi neipi, izvo zvinopa mhedziso imwe chete. Kuyedza kukosha kushoma kwa x chete kana kudhirowa chikamu chete chemitsetse kunosiya nzvimbo dzausina kuyedza, saka hakuvimbisi 'havasangani' (kunogona kushandiswa kutsvaga muenzaniso unopikisa unoratidza kuti vanosangana).
y-m-56-05.s.s2.prompt: Zvino sarudza mutsara M: y = mx + n (m ne n ndema integers kubva ku−9 kusvika ku9) kuti usangane ne L (y = 2x + 1) papoinzi (1, 3) chete. Tsvaga mapeya matatu akasiyana (m, n).
y-m-56-05.s.s2.hint.0: Isa poinzi (1, 3) mu y = mx + n uye ugadzire hukama pakati pe m ne n.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.hint.1: Isa 2 se m uye utarise kuti chii chinoitika kuna M ne L.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.ok.c1: m ne n ndema integers kubva ku−9 kusvika ku9.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.fail.c1: m ne n dzinofanira kuva integers kubva ku−9 kusvika ku9.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Kana waisa x = 1, y haiti 3. Tarisa kana M ichipfuura napo (1, 3).
y-m-56-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Ma slopes akasiyana, saka anosangana papoinzi imwe chete, (1, 3).
y-m-56-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Kana slope iri 2, M inopfuura napoinzi (1, 3) inoenderana zvachose ne L, saka mitsara haisangani papoinzi imwe chete.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.explain: Kuti ipfuure napo (1, 3), m + n = 3. Asi kana m = 2, saka n = 1, saka M inova mutsara mumwe chete ne L uye vanosangana pamapoinzi asingaperi. Saka mapeya (m, n) ane m ≠ 2 chete ndiwo anosangana papoinzi imwe chete. Semuenzaniso: (0, 3), (1, 2), (−1, 4), (5, −2).
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Nyora kuti nei m = 2 isingabvumirwi, uye utaure, uchiisa mamiriro, kuti 'mutsara M unopfuura ne (1, 3) unogara uchisangana ne L papoinzi imwe chete' unogara uri wechokwadi here.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Isa m = 2 mu m + n = 3 kuti utsvage n, uye uenzanise equation yemutsara iwoyo ne L.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Funga kana mitsara miviri ine ma slopes akasiyana inofanira kusangana pane imwe nzvimbo.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa nequation chaiyo kuti mutsara M unova chii kana m = 2 here?
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakapindura 'unogara uri wechokwadi here' nekuisa mamiriro (kana ma slopes akasiyana) here?
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Wakafungawo here nezve nyaya apo ma slopes akafanana asi poinzi yainopfuura nayo yakasiyana (havasangani)?
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana m=2, slope yakafanana, saka mutsara unopfuura ne (1,3) unova y=2x+1 uye unoenderana ne L. Ipapo mitsara inosangana pamapoinzi asingaperi, kwete imwe chete. Saka slope haifaniri kuva 2 kuti vasangane papoinzi imwe chete.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Mutsara upi neupi unopfuura ne (1,3) une slope yakasiyana ne yaL unosangana nayo papoinzi imwe chete. Kana slope iri 2, yakafanana neyaL, ndiyo L pachayo, saka haishande.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Mhinduro iyi yakanyorwa semutsara une mamiriro.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.model.2: Kana m=2, saka n=1 uye inova mutsara mumwe chete ne L, saka vanosangana pamapoinzi asingaperi. Vanosangana papoinzi imwe chete kana slope isiri 2 chete.
